title: gripsack IR v10 workspace
description: One typed workspace of packages, recipes, environments, profiles, tasks, checks and images. Every semantic declaration carries source provenance.

libc.description: e.g. glibc-2.36, musl, darwin; null or absent when undetectable

asset.description: Asset pattern. {version.bare} has one exact stripped spelling; legacy {version} tries the raw tag first, then its one-v-stripped spelling. Platform placeholders are supported.

api_url.description: registry API asset endpoint (authenticated download path); produced by resolution, never written by frontends

args.description: plugin-defined; the parser admits any JSON value here, the authored contract is an object (or absent/null)

options.description: Fixed strict bash option set, in canonical order (plan/0052 §2.2)

path.description: Normalized repository-relative POSIX file path; dot and dot-dot segments, NUL, backslash and empty components are forbidden.

hostRuntimeRequirements.description: Reviewed package-scoped host GNU library roots in declared search order. Not portable artifact content or producer identity.

condaSystemRequirements.description: Linux solve virtual floors. Omitted capabilities retain measured solve assumptions; archive runtime admission remains independent.
